optimizer_map: Obtain the native noisy own-CE gradient/proposed step and native moments/step/buffer transition at the current arm state; snapshot without advancing native RNG twice.

Let private phi_plus be the native private proposal and d0 the native shared displacement. Build B=(theta_old,phi_plus), using the same bound post-native-forward buffer snapshot and dropout-off served-prediction map for all diagnostic/trial states.

Compute current competence support/graph weights at B. Differentiate S_m=sum w_m*t_y^T(z_m-z_bar) only through logits and shared parameters, obtaining up to four h_m. Compute a=shared gradient of uniform pooled TRAIN CE at B.
If no specialist support, a is numerically null, or a^T d0 is not negative, use the native proposal with reason.
Solve min 0.5||c||^2 subject to a^T c=0 and H^T(d0+c)>=0. The projected Gram is H^T(I-aa^T/(a^Ta))H; use a fixed at-most-16-active-set order and prebound residual/tie/rank checks.
If infeasible/numerically unresolved or minimum ||c|| exceeds ||d0||, use native proposal. No ridge, cap enlargement, different block or multiplier search.

Evaluate B, native joint proposal and corrected joint proposal under the same dropout-off map. Require corrected frozen S_m>=S_m(B), corrected pooled CE<=both native joint pooled CE and pooled CE(B), and corrected mean-own CE<=mean-own CE(B), within prebound finite tolerances.

On finite failure use native proposal; otherwise commit native phi_plus, original native moments/step/buffer transition, and theta_old+d0+c. Discard all trial states. Native continuation RNG advances exactly once.

After exactly 32 source-qualified continuation steps, resume the unchanged native optimizer map. Private numeric updates are native at each arm state, not forced identical across divergent trajectories.
